description: The paper map pages of the game, by name. Each key of "paper_maps" is a page id. Scripts and data use these names: sh.event_paper_map_take, sh.paper_map_state / cmd, the save's paper_map_idx, config/paper_map_reveals.json and menu/map_screen.json. The order is the page number the game uses, so never reorder or remove pages. A mod adds pages with a paper_maps.json of the same shape in its folder (ids are namespaced by the mod folder). Generated by tools/scripts/gen_paper_maps.py, which keeps given names.
